title: Reflecting on the Past, Looking to the Future

vocab.ex: It's good to reflect on how far you've come.
When I look back, I see how much I've grown.
That was the turning point in my career.
Learning English was a big achievement for her.
It's time to look ahead and plan the future.
She became an entrepreneur after years as an employee.
Every challenge helped me grow.
I'm proud of the career I've built.
This is the path I chose for my life.
It's been an amazing journey so far.
She built a career she's proud of.
A new opportunity appeared unexpectedly.
Every challenge taught me something new.
I've made a lot of progress this year.
My goal is to speak English fluently.
I set a goal to finish the course by December.
She achieved everything she planned.
Where will you be five years from now?
He mumbled a vague answer.
She used to feel invisible at her old job.
There's a waiting list for the new class.
She always follows up with another question.
Give an honest answer, not a safe one.
Forget what's realistic — dream big.
What would you do if you knew you couldn't fail?
Most people give a safe answer in interviews.
I wondered if I had made a terrible mistake.
She had to learn leadership on her own.
Nobody taught her accounting or marketing.
It wasn't easy, but she kept going.

expressions.example: Where do you see yourself in five years?
Looking back, I'm proud of how far I've come.

My goal is to build a career I truly love.

grammar.title: Falando sobre o Passado e o Futuro: Revisão em Contexto
rules: Para falar de hábitos/estados que mudaram, use USED TO: I used to feel invisible at work.
Para desejos e arrependimentos, use WISH: I wish I had studied business earlier.
Para planos e intenções futuras, use GOING TO: I'm going to build my own career.
Para previsões e decisões espontâneas, use WILL: I think it will be a great journey.

rows: I wish I had started sooner.
I'm going to change my career.
I think it will be worth it.

quiz.q: Where do you ___ yourself in five years?
I ___ (use to) feel invisible at my old job.
I'm ___ (going to) build my own career.
What would you do if you knew you couldn't ___?
